text.en: Tiphera, Archtypes and Harmonization

body.en:
TIPHERA IS THE GAMBLING CHARACTER
Tiphera centers around her (Generally) randomly generated Archtype cards:
Circle ◯, Triangle △ and Square ◻
◯
Heal 60%
1 AP
△
Shield 60%
30% Multiplitive to next Attack card FIRST HIT ONLY
◻
Heal 60%
Draw 1 Archtype
Generally what you create is random, and they can clog the draw pile
ONLY USE QUANTUM SEED WHEN YOU CAN USE FORM RIGHT AFTER
YOU DO NOT WANT ARCHETYPES TO CLOG YOUR DECK

text.en: [Unique] [Initiation] When an Archetype card is moved to hand, duplicate that card and remove a random effect (5 time(s) per turn).

body.en: Form1, Duel 5, Archetype distinct effects and Event Horizon Form Upgrade

Each Archetype comes with 2 distinct effects
◯
Heal 60%
1 AP
Form 1 just doubles one of the lines effect: example
◯ ◯
Heal 120% or Heal 60%
1 AP 2 AP
Duel 5 instead just generates A NEW Archetype, just with one effect removed e.g.
◯ ◯
1 AP or Heal 60%
Event Horizon "Form Upgrade" every Archetype used, upgrade a random effect, e.g.
Event Horizon (Form 0/3) Event Horizon (Form 1/3) Event Horizon Form 3/3)
1 AP 2 AP 1 AP
1 Draw 1 Draw 4 Draw
40% Buff 40% Buff 40% Buff
The line that gets upgraded is random, type of Archetype doesn't effect it

E2 the first 3 Archetypes used each turn create a special one
The Build your own Archtype has effects based on what you used
◯ 160% Healing Worst effect
△ 30% Buff Best effect
◻ Draw 1 Archetype Situational effect
Example:
△△△
90% Buff
◯△◻
160% Healing
30% Buff
Draw 1 Archetype
Usually want to aim for △, ◻ if you need, and not ◯
